'''Murdok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] beast handler living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3639 BBY]] he joined the [[Warstalkers/Legends|Warstalkers]] military company on [[Denova]] after the Warstalker leader [[Kephess]] fell under the influence of the [[Dread Masters]]. Commanding two large [[Drouk]]'s, [[Toth (Drouk)|Toth]] and [[Zorn]], Murdok was trying to stop an enemy force from reaching [[Kephess's Redoubt]], but failed and was killed shortly after his beasts.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Handler Murdok appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a boss during the "Explosive Conflict" operation.
